performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real, but Google zero-conversion and GHL intake leak quietly drain value.

findings.text: SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA marked Done July 20 but no completed event confirmed — verification against live orders is outstanding.
Meta CPL fell 13.76% week-over-week with leads up 40.74% — 153 of 153 28-day leads came from Meta; efficiency is genuine and improving.
Google Ads spent $895.54 over 28 days and recorded 0 conversions — client-side pixel likely missing; spend is unattributed, not necessarily wasted.
GHL shows 153 contacts and 140 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments — leads are entering but not being activated; intake or follow-up leak.
3-day lead signal (Aug 22–24): 0+0+3 = 3 leads vs prior 3-day (Aug 19–21): 2+7+12 = 21 leads — sharp short-term drop despite stable Meta spend ~$86–$102/day.

suggestions.text: Fix Google Ads conversion tracking — $895.54 spent with 0 attributed conversions makes budget defence impossible.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has recorded 0 conversions across $895.54 of 28-day spend, most likely due to a missing or misfired client-side pixel. Audit the conversion tag in Google Tag Manager against the thank-you or call-confirmation event, then QA with Tag Assistant. Success = at least one confirmed conversion firing within 3 days of the fix, by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Diagnose GHL intake leak: 140 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm automation triggers are firing post-lead.
suggestions.monday_update: 153 contacts entered GHL over 28 days producing 140 opportunities but zero appointments booked and zero won — this is an intake or follow-up automation failure, not an ads problem. Check that the post-lead nurture sequence (calls, texts) is triggering correctly for new Meta leads and that the CS team can see and action new opps. Success = appointment count >0 within 7 days, by 2026-09-01.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta 3-day lead drop (3 leads Aug 22–24 vs 21 prior 3 days) — hold budget, re-check Aug 28.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta leads collapsed to 3 over Aug 22–24 versus 21 in the prior 3-day window, despite Meta spend holding at ~$86–$102/day — this is a probable signal, not confirmed noise. Do not cut or scale budget yet; monitor daily leads through Aug 28. If the 3-day rolling total remains below 10 by Aug 28, escalate to creative_refresh or ad-set review.
